source: H.-J. Hagemann, W. Gudat and C. Kunz, DESY report SR-74/7 (May 1974), scanned copy at https://refractiveindex.info/download/data/1974/Hagemann%201974%20-%20DESY%20report%20SR-74-7.pdf (96 PDF pages), SHA-256 f2643a91539506dd6794dde3b4810b91c3c7a24a57f98cf8b8b810e8e0931ed9 (hash recorded 2026-10-09), read 2026-10-07 (Al, Cu), 2026-10-08 (Au, C) and 2026-10-09 (Au Table 6). Tables 2 (Al), 3 (Cu), 5 (Au), 6 (Au, second version, 1.5 to 350 eV only, printed rotated) and 8 (glassy carbon) are PDF pp. 40-42, 43-45, 49-51, 52-54 and 58-59; printed to 3 or 4 digits; above about 120 eV the n column is printed as 1-N; Al2O3 Table 9 (all 100 rows are on PDF pp. 60-61; p. 62 was not opened) read 2026-11-10, hash re-verified the same day
method: Selected rows read by eye from renders of the scan (400 ppi for Al and Cu, 200 ppi for Au and C, 300 ppi rotated by 90 degrees for Au Table 6): N (or 1 - the printed 1-N), K and the ENERGYLOSS column. Au-T6 is Table 6, checked against the transcription Au/nk/Hagemann-2.yml and against au_elf_hagemann1975_t6.toml (issue #314). n_match/k_match compare the reading with the refractiveindex.info transcription row at the same energy (commit c5c2f18). elf_ratio is the committed ELF (formed from the transcription's n, k) divided by the report's printed ENERGYLOSS. Al2O3 (issue #598): all 100 rows of Table 9 (page 1 and page 2) read by eye on 2026-11-10 from 300 ppi renders rotated by 90 degrees (the table is printed rotated), N, K and ENERGYLOSS; the report prints N directly (no 1-N) for Al2O3. The reading was made from the scan, the transcription (Al2O3/nk/Hagemann.yml, commit c5c2f18) is the comparison only; n_match is equality at the printed digits, k_match is agreement within 0.6 % (the printed 3 significant digits)
